question: Rishabh starts from Point A and drives 9 km towards west. He then takes a left turn, drives 8 km, turns left and drives 15 km. He then takes a right turn and drives 6 km. He takes a final right turn, drives 6 km and stops at Point P. How far (shortest distance) and towards which direction should he drive in order to reach Point A again? (All turns are 90° turns only unless specified.)
solution:
• Rishabh starts from Point A and drives 9 km towards west.
 
• He then takes a left turn, drives 8 km, turns left and drives 15 km.
 
• He then takes a right turn and drives 6 km.
 
• He takes a final right turn, drives 6 km and stops at Point P.
